title: NANPA authority for shard-A NPAs 765, 771, 774 and 786

data.notes: Current numbering materials identify 765 (Indiana), 771 (District of Columbia 202 overlay), 774 (Massachusetts 508 overlay), and 786 (Florida 305/645 overlay complex) as in-service U.S. geographic NPAs. Each satisfies shard-A rule integer(NPA) mod 3 == 0.

title: Muncie Food Not Bombs recent public activity

data.notes: September 2025 local public-media reporting documents Muncie Food Not Bombs as reorganized and conducting weekly Heekin Park meal shares. This establishes recent activity; no independent 2026 first-party status confirmation was located in this bounded pass.

title: Ayuda Mutua Lafayette current public hub

data.notes: Current public Linktree self-describes Ayuda Mutua Lafayette as an immigrant-led mutual-aid organization focused on food insecurity, community care, defense and knowledge, and exposes current 2026 events plus public Facebook, Instagram, email, donation and rapid-response surfaces.

title: East of the River Mutual Aid current first-party site

data.publisher: East of the River Mutual Aid
data.notes: Current first-party site identifies East of the River Mutual Aid as a peoples collective operating under solidarity rather than charity, says it co-founded the DC Mutual Aid Network, and describes active food pop-ups, packing/delivery and community-building work.

title: Ward 4 Mutual Aid current first-party site

data.notes: Current first-party site describes Ward 4 Neighbors Helping Neighbors / Ward 4 Mutual Aid as a grassroots D.C. network based on solidarity, mutual aid and autonomous direct action, with current grocery/diaper distribution, unhoused outreach and direct cash assistance.

title: DC Fair Food current first-party site

data.notes: Current first-party site identifies DC Fair Food as a community-based food-justice ally collective founded in 2010, organizing in solidarity with the Coalition of Immokalee Workers and other community/mutual-aid groups, with recurring Saturday activity in Mt. Pleasant and a public organizational email.

title: Worcester Food Not Bombs current chapter listing

data.notes: Current Boston Food Not Bombs chapter page lists Worcester Food Not Bombs as an independent Massachusetts chapter and publishes the public handle @woofoodnotbombs. Historical Food Not Bombs directories also place the chapter in Worcester with a 774 contact number, but current status here is based on the fresh chapter listing.

title: The Village Worcester current first-party site

data.notes: Current first-party page states that the Stone Soup Artist/Activist Collective and Community Resource Center transitioned into The Village Worcester in September 2020. The Village describes itself as an Afrocentric cultural, learning and healing center building grassroots power among Black/BIPOC groups, healers and organizers at 4 King Street, Worcester.

title: Food Not Bombs Miami current first-party site

data.notes: Current first-party site identifies Food Not Bombs Miami as a non-hierarchical decentralized mutual-aid network serving Miami and South Florida, and exposes public email, Instagram @foodnotbombsmiami and Facebook surfaces plus recurring food/resource-share information.

title: South Florida ABCF current federation listing

data.notes: Current Anarchist Black Cross Federation contact directory lists South Florida ABCF at a Miami address via Cienfuegos Cooperative and provides the collective's public federation contact. Existing corpus research also records public Instagram @abc.sfl; this pass re-verifies the federation listing rather than creating a duplicate organization identity.
